cards.title: Floor and Agent grid pages left in the tree with no way in (since 2026-09-22)

cards.title: OpenCode support removed 2026-09-23
cards.user_does: Launched OpenCode as an agent and tracked its usage.
cards.user_sees: OpenCode was a launchable agent with its own settings, status-bar usage for OpenCode Go, session history and a status hook plugin.
rules: Owner's call: focus on the frontier-lab agents.

cards.title: Kolux Account cloud sign-in and its settings page: hidden 2026-09-28, removed 2026-10-05

cards.user_sees: A settings page offered sign-in to a first-party Kolux Cloud service that gated the cloud features.

The preview takes a grid-size claim so it does not fight the main pane over terminal size.

cards.title: Shared message box under a workspace's panes, with an agent chooser and a permission chip, removed 2026-09-15
cards.user_does: Typed into the single box docked beneath a workspace's panes, chose which running agent should receive the text, and flipped a chip so the next agent started in that workspace would not stop for permission prompts.
cards.user_sees: In 0.5.0, one box per workspace with an agent chip listing the agents running there, an on/off permission chip, the branch name and a send arrow; a toast said the text was sent to the named agent or that sending failed.
rules: The box always aimed at exactly one chosen agent, never at the whole workspace; by default the agent of the focused pane, otherwise the first agent able to take text.
An agent joined the chooser only after it signalled it was ready; with no agent running the box was greyed out, and sending needed non-blank text and a ready agent.
Enter sent and Shift+Enter added a line; Tab in an empty box stepped to the next agent; Escape put the cursor back in the terminal; unsent drafts were kept per agent until reload.
The permission chip stored a per-workspace choice layered over the global default; it changed only agents launched afterwards, never one already running.

Taken out that same night in the sidebar trim, once every session had its own pane and typing into the pane already reached the agent; the stored per-workspace permission choice outlived it and is still applied at launch (area 05, VIEW-054), though no visible control sets it any more (see notes).
Not the dialog for creating a new workspace, which shares the composer name in the old code and stays.
acceptance: Default build → nothing sits beneath a workspace's panes for messaging agents.
With a skip-permissions choice already stored for one workspace, launch an agent there → it starts without permission prompts; a second workspace follows the global default.
cards.compat: A per-workspace permission choice saved by this era's builds must still load and apply at the next launch in that workspace; a malformed entry is dropped on load.

notes: 44 cards, above the expected 20-35, because each retired item gets its own one-line card and the 158 area-21 tests are all Agent Dashboard drawer tests (D-21-020 to D-21-023).
Unreachable but still in the old tree: the Activity page (opener has no production caller), the Floor and Agent grid pages (Floor only via an unbound command) and the standalone terminal window.
The drawer's on/off setting experimentalAgentDashboardPopout is still named for the retired pop-out; with it off the dashboard.toggle shortcut is silently inert.
Overlaps: flag cards D-21-024 to D-21-032 also touch areas 03, 05, 14, 15 and 18; the cloud-feature removals touch 07, 15 and 18; D-21-030 to D-21-032 are D because their features are cut elsewhere.
UNKNOWN: what the fork-retired enableGitHubAttribution setting did, and the exact date the sidebar per-agent rows died (only bounded as before 2026-09-22).
UNKNOWN: whether profiles have any user entry point beyond the dev-build Dev Tools preview; none was found in the renderer.
Ambiguous: the 2026-09-23 OpenCode removal lists a pet among the removed parts, yet the experimental pet flag and its characters still exist.
Provenance unknown for 9 notification sounds and 12 onboarding feature-wall GIFs; no e2e specs map to area 21; git-commit evidence entries cite old-repo commits.

Wave 2 (2026-10-06): D-21-045 added for the 0.5.0 workspace message box. UNKNOWN: after its removal no renderer component or CLI command calls the per-workspace permission setter; the stored value is still read at launch and accepted by the client UI-state schema, so VIEW-054 (area 05) may describe a control that no longer exists in the shipped UI.
